name: Supplier Balance Report
sql_query:
SELECT
    s.Code                                                        AS supplier_code,
    s.name                                                        AS supplier_name,
    s.phone,
    CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(s.type, 1)), SUBSTRING(s.type, 2))          AS type,
    COALESCE(p.open_grns, 0)                                      AS open_grns,
    COALESCE(p.purchase_value, 0)                                 AS purchase_value,
    COALESCE(p.purchase_paid, 0)                                  AS purchase_paid,
    COALESCE(p.purchase_due, 0)                                   AS purchase_due,
    COALESCE(r.repair_due, 0)                                     AS repair_due,
    COALESCE(p.purchase_due, 0) + COALESCE(r.repair_due, 0)       AS total_due,
    NULLIF(LEAST(COALESCE(p.oldest_grn, '9999-12-31'), COALESCE(r.oldest_repair, '9999-12-31')), '9999-12-31') AS oldest_due_date,
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), LEAST(COALESCE(p.oldest_grn, '9999-12-31'), COALESCE(r.oldest_repair, '9999-12-31'))) AS oldest_due_days
FROM suppliers s
LEFT JOIN (
    -- Unpaid / part-paid GRNs
    SELECT supplier_code,
           COUNT(*)                         AS open_grns,
           SUM(Net_Amount)                  AS purchase_value,
           SUM(paid_amount)                 AS purchase_paid,
           SUM(Net_Amount - paid_amount)    AS purchase_due,
           MIN(Invoice_date)                AS oldest_grn
    FROM t_purchases_sums
    WHERE BC = :bc
      AND Net_Amount - paid_amount > 0.009
    GROUP BY supplier_code
) p ON p.supplier_code = s.Code
LEFT JOIN (
    -- Repairs received back from the supplier but not fully paid
    SELECT supplier_code,
           SUM(repair_cost - paid_amount)   AS repair_due,
           MIN(COALESCE(received_date, dispatch_date)) AS oldest_repair
    FROM t_service_dispatches
    WHERE BC = :bc
      AND status = 'received_back'
      AND repair_cost - paid_amount > 0.009
    GROUP BY supplier_code
) r ON r.supplier_code = s.Code
WHERE s.BC = :bc
  AND (:supplier IS NULL OR s.Code = :supplier)
  AND (:type     IS NULL OR s.type = :type)
  AND (COALESCE(:show, 'due') = 'all'
       OR COALESCE(p.purchase_due, 0) + COALESCE(r.repair_due, 0) > 0.009)
ORDER BY total_due DESC, s.name;
